interpretation.conclusion: Speaker resampling alone suffices to reproduce the full observed trial-to-joint separation-loss pattern on these fixed scores; attack-only reproduces four of the eight losses. This is not an additive variance decomposition or causal attribution to speaker identity.
interpretation.paper_sentence: In an exploratory post-review primary-21DF ablation using the same B=5000 threshold refits and 28-pair simultaneous construction, speaker-only resampling reproduced all eight trial-to-joint losses (18/28 separated), whereas attack-only reproduced four (22/28), showing that speaker resampling alone suffices for the full observed loss pattern.
